name: 77065 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77065 (Houston) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 45 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77065 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77065 (Houston) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
